invariance_comparison.interpretation: Numerical audit only; affine invariance is mathematical, while float32 rounding can cause small differences.

notes: Within-recording AUCs are exploratory and can be unstable with few positive windows.
AUC below 0.5 means the feature is lower in seizure windows for that recording; it does not justify reversing a feature or score.
The patient-level OOF model and its predictions are unchanged.
